name: Tama
source: Tama is a marriage deity that resides with Naoto in his apartment. She has the power to assist people in creating interpersonal bonds with other residents (and potential residents) of the apartment building she is bound to. She often forces Naoto to do his job by threatening to curse him. Her physical form is a stuffed animal that she possesses freely.
